get.description:
Retrieves the current `SystemStateVector`, a high-dimensional representation of the system's runtime status. This endpoint is critical for monitoring the `activeContext` and ensuring the coherence of the distributed processing graph.

The response aggregates real-time telemetry from the kernel, application layer, and external interfaces. It is primarily used by the Watchdog service and the Auto-Scaling Orchestrator to make heuristic decisions about resource allocation and context switching.

**Performance Note:** Requesting a `contextDepth` greater than 5 may result in significant latency due to the recursive traversal of the context graph.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: If set to `true`, the response includes granular metrics for every subsystem involved in the state vector calculation, including raw memory pointers and thread stack traces.

parameters.name: contextDepth
parameters.description: Defines the recursion depth for the `activeContext` analysis. Higher values provide a more comprehensive view of the context tree but increase computational load.

parameters.name: vectorFormat
parameters.description: Specifies the serialization format of the numerical vector data. 'dense' returns a standard array, 'sparse' returns index-value pairs, and 'binary' returns a base64 encoded byte stream.

parameters.name: X-Correlation-ID
parameters.description: A unique identifier used to trace the request across distributed system components.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the System State Vector.

nominalState.description: Example of a healthy system state with a shallow context depth.

highLoadState.description: Example of a system under heavy load with degraded coherence.

schema.description: Protocol Buffers binary stream of the SystemStateVector.

400.description: Bad Request. Invalid parameters provided, such as a negative context depth.

401.description: Unauthorized. The request lacks valid authentication credentials.

403.description: Forbidden. The authenticated user does not have permission to view system state vectors.

429.description: Too Many Requests. The system is currently calculating a state vector for another high-priority process and cannot accept new requests.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before making a new request.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Failed to aggregate state vector due to a subsystem failure.
